from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import UnitaryGate
import numpy as np

def solve(theta: float) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # e^{i theta} |0> = e^{i theta} I |0>
    # The unitary e^{i theta} I has first column [e^{i theta},0]^T
    phase = np.exp(1j * theta)
    mat = np.array([[phase, 0.0],
                    [0.0, phase]], dtype=complex)
    qc.append(UnitaryGate(mat), [0])
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve(theta: float) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # X P(theta) X = diag(e^{i theta}, 1)
    # Acting on |0> this gives e^{i theta}|0>
    qc.x(0)
    qc.p(theta, 0)
    qc.x(0)
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit.library import GlobalPhaseGate

def solve(theta: float) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # A true global phase can be applied with GlobalPhaseGate.
    # It leaves |0> unchanged up to the overall factor e^{i theta}.
    qc.append(GlobalPhaseGate(theta), [])
    return qc

from qiskit import QuantumCircuit

def solve(theta: float) -> QuantumCircuit:
    qc = QuantumCircuit(1)
    # RZ(phi)|0> = e^{-i phi/2}|0>
    # choose phi = -2*theta  =>  e^{-i phi/2}=e^{i theta}
    qc.rz(-2.0 * theta, 0)
    return qc
